SAMVectorsearchMetadata.description: Smarter API Vectorsearch Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMVectorsearchMetadata.title: SAMVectorsearchMetadata

config.description: Vectorsearch.spec.config[object]. The configuration for the Vectorsearch.

auth_secret_name.description: Optional name of the Secret used to authenticate against the Vectorstore, if required.
auth_secret_name.title: Auth Secret Name

fetch_k.description: Number of candidate documents to fetch before MMR re-ranking. Only valid when search_type='mmr'.
fetch_k.title: Fetch K

is_enabled.description: Whether this Vectorsearch is active and eligible to be queried.
is_enabled.title: Is Enabled

k.description: Number of top results to return from the search.
k.title: K

lambda_mult.description: Diversity vs. relevance trade-off for MMR (0.0=max diversity, 1.0=max relevance). Only valid when search_type='mmr'.
lambda_mult.title: Lambda Mult

metadata_filter.description: Optional metadata filter applied to the Vectorstore query, e.g. {'source': 'faq'}.
metadata_filter.title: Metadata Filter

score_threshold.description: Minimum relevance score a result must meet to be included. Only valid when search_type='similarity_score_threshold'.
score_threshold.title: Score Threshold

search_type.description: The retrieval strategy to use when querying the Vectorstore.

vectorstore_name.description: The name of the locally-hosted Vectorstore this search queries against.
vectorstore_name.title: Vectorstore Name
